indicator_name: Months with a utility price change in the CPI (month on month), by service
description: Месяцы изменения цен на коммунальные услуги в ИПЦ (м/м), по услугам
methodology: Derived, not published: the months in which the national CPI item of a utility moved by at least 3% m/m, or by at least 1.5% with a robust z-score (median/MAD over the item's history) of at least 5; both directions. Items ELECTRICITY, HOT_WATER, COLD_WATER, HEATING, SEWERAGE, NETWORK_GAS, LPG, GARBAGE, each a chain of the BNS item slugs of CPI_DETAIL_MOM across basket re-bases (item_name names the slug). Measures when a tariff change reached the prices BNS registers, NOT the decision date (TARIFF_DECISIONS); a change in one city moves the national item by a fraction of its size. National only: the regional CPI rows carry no utility items. 314 flagged months 2004-2026 (2026-09-27).
